subject: Mosasaurus, Plesiosaurus, and Ichthyosaurus Underwater Group Shot
prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated style. Ultra-bright, sun-drenched marine lighting filtering down through crystal-clear turquoise waters onto a vibrant, shallow epicontinental reef. A friendly Mosasaurus, Plesiosaurus, and Ichthyosaurus are grouped together swimming side-by-side, smiling unconcernedly with healthy, rounded, non-threatening teeth visible. Saturation is high with vivid coral pinks, seafoam greens, and warm golden sun-rays dancing across their skin. Caption in the upper third: 'Marine Smile!' in bright red, thick 3D mixed-case block letters with a glossy finish. Satiny-smooth skin and soft leathery aquatic textures. No dark shadows on faces; completely illuminated underwater landscape that feels entirely inviting and cheerful.
visual_logic: Matches the exact brightness, saturation, and 'Success' energy of the Player Wins card to create a cohesive brand look.
